title: Implement alias optimization

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 alias-optimization capability assessment for the exact current source forest
scope.implementation_delta: No current-head Python implementation is an alias optimizer for PCSM. PCSM-014 supplies only the receipt-bound alias-to-canonical identity boundary, while the existing supervisor token ledger supplies deterministic provider/tokenizer-bound cost accounting. Neither selects aliases using token cost, frequency, dictionary/grammar overhead, prefix reuse, semantic-anchor value, expansion probability, or ambiguity. The exact declared-output authority forbids implementing the missing source package or tests here, so this receipt makes the gap explicit rather than creating a competing or untested optimizer.

pcsm_014_alias_boundary.meaning: A receipt-bound composition of local-name-to-canonical-CID bindings and collision controls. A local alias is never canonical identity.
pcsm_014_alias_boundary.not_an_optimizer: It deliberately defers tokenizer-optimized alias selection to PCSM-043 through PCSM-045 and is neither a registered optimizer schema nor a construction algorithm.

pcsm_042_cost_prerequisite.determinism_and_binding: It provides immutable content-addressed provider/model/tokenizer envelopes and deterministic calibrated-fallback accounting. Provider-native use is measured only from supplied provider usage; calibrated fallback is explicitly estimated.
pcsm_042_cost_prerequisite.not_an_optimizer: It has no alias candidate input, deterministic score/ranking, collision-safe alias selection, alias-table output, or alias-to-canonical relinking. Token accounting cannot be substituted for optimization.
